projects.name: /Senior Business Analyst
details: • Led a Greenfield project for Claims Monitoring process across financial services, managing end-to-end delivery and
ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and business strategy for global banks.
• Strengthened governance and controls by establishing clear data ownership, embedding traceability frameworks,
and improving reference data accuracy, reliability, and regulatory compliance.
• Designed and published KPI dashboards in Power BI to provide stakeholders with real-time visibility of sprint
progress, enabling transparent reporting and informed decision-making.
• Facilitated Agile delivery by implementing weekly Scrum ceremonies, driving backlog refinement, and closing
knowledge gaps through continuous team coaching.
• Enhanced stakeholder engagement through regular status meetings and feedback forums, ensuring alignment of
deliverables with business expectations.
• Introduced process improvements such as an internal contact management tool that reduced reliance on external
data sources and streamlined stakeholder communication.
• Documented detailed user stories with acceptance criteria, prototypes, and business value, ensuring traceability
from requirements to testing and delivery.
• Performed gap, scope, and impact analyses using modelling techniques (UML, BPMN, Visio, Lucidchart) to define AS- IS/TO-BE processes and identify optimization opportunities.
• Led a 14-member team in requirements elicitation through interviews, questionnaires, interface analysis, document
analysis, brainstorming sessions, and focus groups.
• Partnered with cross-functional teams during development, integration testing, functional testing, and UAT,
ensuring error-free delivery and seamless transition into BAU.
